paper_id: RS5M and GeoRSCLIP_ A Large Scale Vision-Language Dataset and A Large Vision-Language Model for Remote Sensing
title: RS5M and GeoRSCLIP: A Large Scale Vision-Language Dataset and A Large Vision-Language Model for Remote Sensing
motivation: 通用VLM在常见物体上训练,在遥感等专业领域表现不佳,领域迁移困难
problem_framing: 提出DVLM框架,将通用视觉-语言模型知识迁移到遥感下游任务
key_insight: 通过构建大规模遥感图像-文本配对数据集RS5M并微调CLIP,可有效弥合领域差距
method_signature: 过滤大规模图文数据集+BLIP2为遥感图生成caption+PEFT微调CLIP
evaluation_criteria: 零样本分类准确率、跨模态检索召回率、语义定位指标
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: PEFT方法不能达到全量微调的同等效果;数据存在地理分布不均问题
evidence_for_taste: they do not consistently achieve the same level of effectiveness
the RS3 subset may contain wrong captions or misleading information
around 0.8% of images in the sampled RS5M images are outliers
low image density areas are overlapped with many underdevelopment areas
thinking_moves: 先构建领域数据集解决数据稀缺瓶颈,再通过PEFT实现高效迁移
用旋转不变性准则筛选caption,排除幻觉文本
区分PUB11(航拍图)和RS3(卫星图)分析各自贡献
承认PEFT与全量微调存在效果差距,指出效率优势作为补偿
topic_tags: 大规模图文数据集构建
